shortDescription: Free hint-first crossword vocabulary solver and printable practice packs for Grades 6–12.
fullDescription: Crossword Clue Tutor is a free, account-free classroom resource that helps students infer vocabulary from clue wording, answer length, grammar, and trusted crossing letters before revealing an answer. It includes a reduced-analytics classroom solver, 160 original reviewed clues across 12 skill areas, printable student sheets with teacher keys, and a 20-minute vocabulary-learning guide. Subjects include language arts, reading, writing, math, science, social studies, digital and media literacy, financial literacy, and environmental literacy. Full disclosure: I maintain the resource.
